name: Twin Bridges Half Marathon Muar 2026
short_description: A 21.1km half marathon held on October 25, 2026, at Dataran Tanjung Emas in Muar, Johor, Malaysia.
ai_summary: The Twin Bridges Half Marathon Muar 2026 is a half marathon event scheduled for October 25, 2026, in Muar, Johor, Malaysia. The race covers a distance of 21.1 kilometers and starts at Dataran Tanjung Emas. Registration is currently open for runners interested in participating in this Malaysian road race.
pros: Registration is currently open, allowing runners time to plan and sign up
Single half-marathon distance of 21.1km keeps the event focused
Centrally located at Dataran Tanjung Emas in Muar, Johor
research_highlights: The 2026 edition is scheduled for Sunday, 25 October 2026, starting at 4:15am from Dataran Tanjung Emas, Muar, Johor.
Distance categories offered are 5km, 11km and 21km, with entry fees starting from RM50.
The race is organised locally, technically run by Pusat Khidmat Rakyat Parlimen Bakri, and involves Muar's local MPs/ADUNs as organisers.
The course theme centers on Muar's two river bridges — the Sultan Ismail Bridge and the Muar Second Bridge — crossing the Muar River in the historic royal town of Bandar Maharani.
The 2024 edition drew around 3,200 participants, per the organiser's own event recap video.
